contexts.text: They have one end, that is, the common good...
When the common good of society is the end of all... AC 1316:end.
Man's proprium... turns the common good of society... to self...

So with those who persuade themselves that their own profit is the common good, and account nothing as the common good but what is also their own... They who are of such a character as to regard what is their own as the common good, or to veil it over with the appearance that it is the common good, in the other life act in the same way in relation to the common good there.
Those are in self love who... care nothing whatever about the common good, unless it is for them, and they themselves are as it were it.
They say that the common good is still more their neighbour...
In the beginning every one is affected... for the sake of the common good...
They think that such things are not only against their religion, but also against the common good...
Use and end for the sake of the common good...
All uses... taken together make and perfect the general use, which is the common good.
He who is for the common good in the life of the body is also for the common good in the other life; the common good in the other life is the Lord's Kingdom...
The common good exists from the goods of use performed by individuals, and the goods of use performed by individuals subsist from the common good. General article.
The common good consists of the following things. Enumerated.
Ministries, etc... are the goods of use which individuals perform, from which the common good exists. General article.
